_comment: Amaro Lab (UCSD) published MD datasets under 1 GB. Sizes are Content-Length in bytes, verified by HEAD request 2026-11-10. Source page: https://amarolab.ucsd.edu/data.php -- its /files/ links 302-redirect to Globus HTTPS endpoints.

datasets.components: protein only (dry: no water, no ions)
cannot_answer: anything involving water, ions or solvation
absolute timescales unless the timestep is confirmed with the lab

larger_alternatives.name: trajectories_nsp14_namd_dry
larger_alternatives.what: the NAMD run of the same system; longer than the Amber trajectory in this collection

topology.psf_style: standard: real segids and real amino-acid resnames

datasets.system: SARS-CoV-2 nsp14 in complex with its nsp10 cofactor
datasets.components: protein only (dry: no water, no ions)
answers: how nsp10 binding changes nsp14 dynamics (compare against the nsp14 dataset)
interface contacts between nsp14 and nsp10
cannot_answer: anything involving water, ions or solvation

larger_alternatives.name: trajectories_nsp14_nsp10_namd_dry
larger_alternatives.what: NAMD run of the same system

topology.psf_style: NON-STANDARD: the segid column is BLANK and the chain label sits in the resname field, so the real amino-acid names are absent from this file
topology.warning: `protein`, `backbone` and `segid N14` all return ZERO atoms — silently, not as an error. Select chains by resname and name atoms explicitly.

select.nsp14_backbone: resname N14 and name N CA C O

topology.note: Comparing against the apo `nsp14` dataset requires DIFFERENT selection syntax for each file: `segid N14` there, `resname N14` here. The resid numbering matches (2-526 both), so per-residue comparison is valid once selected correctly.

datasets.system: SARS-CoV-2 nsp14/nsp10 complex with RNA bound

answers: how RNA binding changes protein dynamics (compare against nsp14-nsp10)
cannot_answer: anything involving water, ions or solvation

_not_fetchable: Entries under 'larger_alternatives' are reference only: they record what the Amaro Lab publishes beyond this collection's 1 GB cut-off, so a question needing them can be answered honestly without a download. They carry no URL and no 'files' list, and fetch_dataset() cannot retrieve them. Point the user at https://amarolab.ucsd.edu/data.php instead.
_known_broken: fl-A3B.tar.gz (APOBEC3B, ~880 MB) is listed on the Amaro Lab page but its link is relative and does not resolve (HTTP 404). Excluded for that reason, not by size. Worth reporting to the lab.
